verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships a polished desktop app and a self-hosted web UI with rich features (agents, RAG, MCP, chat widgets) beyond basic chat, corroborated by hands-on community feedback praising the desktop packaging. However, there is no evidence of an official mobile app, so cross-surface parity (web/desktop/mobile) is incomplete. Missing for 10: official mobile app, explicit feature-parity comparison across web/desktop/mobile surfaces.
